description.en:
The book-fold phone as a parametric archetype: two rigid half-frames on a fold axis along the long edge, one continuous display folded inward across both of them, a cover display outside, a teardrop crease relief, and one continuous fold angle from closed to open. Named devices ride as presets whose every millimetre is a published dimension with a provenance line — the half thickness is the manufacturer's own open depth and the gap is what their closed depth leaves over. No logos, no trade dress. Dual-engine: a CadQuery reference and a node-graph twin.

Official Visualizer and Configurator: Yantra4D
description.es: El teléfono plegable de libro como arquetipo paramétrico: dos medios marcos rígidos sobre un eje de plegado en el borde largo, una pantalla continua plegada hacia dentro sobre ambos, una pantalla de portada por fuera, un alojamiento de pliegue en gota y un ángulo de apertura continuo de cerrado a abierto. Los dispositivos con nombre viajan como preajustes cuyos milímetros son todos dimensiones publicadas con su procedencia — el espesor de cada mitad es la profundidad abierta del propio fabricante y la holgura es lo que sobra de su profundidad cerrada. Sin logotipos ni imagen comercial. Doble motor: una referencia en CadQuery y un gemelo en grafo de nodos.

cdg_interfaces.standard: internal: the closed outline — hinge_axis_length x cover_half_width x (2 x half_thickness + the hinge gap), with the opening edge rounded by corner_radius. An accessory that takes a device envelope mates here. The OPEN outline is hinge_axis_length x (cover_half_width + camera_half_width) x half_thickness.

internal: the X axis through the origin, in the MIDDLE of the gap between the two half-frames. The gap is the published closed depth less twice the published open depth; it exists only when the device is closed, because a turn about this axis lands both halves in one z band. fold_angle 0 closed, 180 open.
internal: the strip of the folding panel that bends, centred on the fold axis and running the display's full width along it. What the hinge's relief is sized to give room to.
internal: a rectangular aperture of the cover display's active area, sunk display_recess_depth into the cover half's outer face. The same id the clamshell cartridge's display_panel component exposes.

internal: a recessed camera island with a row of circular apertures sunk through its floor, in the camera half's outer face. A RECESS, not a raised bump — every depth published in this family excludes the camera bump and none publishes its height.
internal: a rectangular pocket in the cover half's opening edge, for a power or volume key. The same id the clamshell cartridge's face_button and button_row components expose, in a third arrangement.
internal: a rectangular opening in the cover half's end face, sized to clear a USB-C receptacle. Present only where the registry lists the port.
internal: a SIM-tray mouth in the cover half's end face. Present only where the registry lists a `sim` port; an eSIM-only device has a SOURCED absence, not an unknown.
internal: the cover half's outer face and its footprint — the surface a dock, stand or cradle registers against when the device is closed.

societal_benefit.en: A dimensioned, parametric model of the book-fold phones people actually own lets anyone fabricate a cradle, a dock, a travel shell, a screen-protector jig or a repair fixture that fits — for hardware whose manufacturer publishes an outline and nothing else. It also makes the family's own arithmetic legible: the gap between the two halves, the dimension that separates a 2019 fold from a 2026 one, is not a styling claim but the difference between two published numbers, and this cartridge is where you can see it.
societal_benefit.es: Un modelo paramétrico y acotado de los plegables de libro que la gente tiene permite fabricar una base, un dock, una funda de viaje, una plantilla de protector o un útil de reparación que encaje — para equipos cuyo fabricante publica un contorno y nada más. Además hace legible la aritmética de la familia: la holgura entre las dos mitades, la dimensión que separa un plegable de 2019 de uno de 2026, no es una afirmación de estilo sino la diferencia entre dos cifras publicadas.

composition.vocabulary: Telesia docs/DEVICE_GEOMETRY.md §3.1 (components are hyperobjects too); gate H8 there rules how a component cartridge will feed an assembly cartridge.
composition.note: A device is a hyperobject of hyperobjects: a display, a hinge, a lens window, a button, a port and a card tray are each one in their own right and feed into this one. main.py builds each through its own function taking its own parameter dict, so any of them can be lifted into its own cartridge without a rewrite; bookfold.graph.json groups each one's nodes under the same slug as a node-id prefix. `component:<slug>` cannot be spelled literally in a node id — the transpiler's grammar is ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ — so the prefix is the slug plus an underscore. Sub-graph reuse (yantra4d lane G-CLUSTERS) is what would let the twin REFERENCE a component cartridge instead of duplicating its nodes. Three of these components — display_panel, port_receptacle and the button seat — already exist in the clamshell-dual-screen-handheld cartridge under the same interface ids, which is the concrete duplication G-CLUSTERS and gate H8 would remove.

components.note: one panel across both halves; the component builds one half's portion, from the fold axis outward
no upstream CDG id; a vented face is not a mating feature

description.en: All three parts in world coordinates at the current fold angle. Not a print target — the parts are separate bodies held apart by the fold.
description.es: Las tres piezas en coordenadas de mundo al ángulo de plegado actual. No es un objetivo de impresión — las piezas son cuerpos separados.

description.en: The same three parts built from the node graph. Server-only, and gated to pro and premium like every graph cartridge.
description.es: Las mismas tres piezas construidas desde el grafo de nodos. Sólo en servidor, y limitado a pro y premium como todo cartucho de grafo.

tooltip.en: The long axis, X. Both halves share it, and the fold axis runs along it. In a preset this is the registry's closed height — which equals the published OPEN height on every device in this family that gives both.
tooltip.es: El eje largo, X. Ambas mitades lo comparten y el eje de plegado corre por él. En un preajuste es la altura cerrada del registro — igual a la altura ABIERTA publicada en todos los dispositivos de esta familia que dan ambas.

label.es: Ancho de la mitad de portada (mm)

tooltip.en: The folding axis, Y, for the half that carries the cover display. It runs from the fold at y=0 to its opening edge. In a preset this is the registry's closed width — the closed device is exactly this wide.
tooltip.es: El eje de plegado, Y, para la mitad que lleva la pantalla de portada. Va del pliegue en y=0 a su borde de apertura. En un preajuste es el ancho cerrado del registro.

label.es: Ancho de la mitad de cámara (mm)

tooltip.en: The other half, which is NARROWER — that is why a book fold closes. In a preset it is the published open width less the published closed width, so both ends of the subtraction are the manufacturer's.
tooltip.es: La otra mitad, MÁS ESTRECHA — por eso cierra un plegable de libro. En un preajuste es el ancho abierto publicado menos el ancho cerrado publicado, así que ambos extremos de la resta son del fabricante.

tooltip.en: One half's thickness, Z. In a preset this is the registry's published OPEN depth: the open body is one half. The closed depth is twice this plus the hinge gap, and that is what the closed envelope is verified against.
tooltip.es: El espesor de una mitad, Z. En un preajuste es la profundidad ABIERTA publicada del registro: el cuerpo abierto es una mitad. La profundidad cerrada es el doble más la holgura de bisagra.

tooltip.en: Rounding on the two vertical edges of the OPENING edge only; the spine stays square in plan. ARCHETYPE DEFAULT: no manufacturer in this family publishes a corner radius (0 of 84 devices in the registry), so this is ours at every preset.
tooltip.es: Redondeo sólo en las dos aristas verticales del borde de apertura; el lomo queda recto en planta. VALOR DEL ARQUETIPO: ningún fabricante de esta familia publica un radio de esquina (0 de 84 dispositivos), así que es nuestro en todos los preajustes.

tooltip.en: 0 closed, 180 open. The camera half turns about the fold axis, which is the X axis through the origin in the middle of the gap — which is why the gap closes itself as the device opens.
tooltip.es: 0 cerrado, 180 abierto. La mitad de cámara gira sobre el eje de plegado, el eje X por el origen en medio de la holgura — por eso la holgura se cierra sola al abrir.

label.es: Centro Y de la mitad de portada (mm)

tooltip.en: Half of the cover-half width. Its own parameter because the graph format has no arithmetic (lane G-EXPR); the generator emits it with the width so the two cannot drift.
tooltip.es: La mitad del ancho de la mitad de portada. Es su propio parámetro porque el formato de grafo no tiene aritmética (lane G-EXPR).

label.es: Centro Z de la mitad de portada (mm)

tooltip.en: Negative half the gap, less half the thickness. THE HINGE GAP LIVES HERE: with no expressions, the gap — this family's defining dimension — cannot be a control of its own, only the two centres that carry it. Each preset records the gap in millimetres under its `registry` block.
tooltip.es: Menos media holgura, menos medio espesor. AQUÍ VIVE LA HOLGURA DE BISAGRA: sin expresiones, la holgura no puede ser un control propio. Cada preajuste la anota en milímetros en su bloque `registry`.

tooltip.en: Half of the camera-half width, before the fold.
tooltip.es: La mitad del ancho de la mitad de cámara, antes del plegado.

tooltip.en: Half the gap plus half the thickness — the mirror of the cover half's, which is what makes a 180° turn land the two halves coplanar.
tooltip.es: Media holgura más medio espesor — el espejo del de la mitad de portada, que es lo que hace que un giro de 180° deje ambas mitades coplanares.

tooltip.en: The relief both halves give up along the fold so the folding panel's bend has room. A cylinder ON the fold axis, so it is invariant under the fold. ARCHETYPE: capped by the wall it must leave against the outer face.

tooltip.en: How far the relief runs along the fold axis — 94 % of the hinge-axis length, so the two ends stay solid.

message.en: The crease relief must be larger than the leaf that turns in it, or the frames and the hinge occupy the same space. Set hinge_leaf_radius = hinge_cavity_radius - running clearance (archetype: 0.3 mm).

message.en: The crease relief is deeper than a half-frame is thick: it would cut straight through the outer face. Reduce hinge_cavity_radius, or make the halves thicker.
message.es: El alojamiento del pliegue es más profundo que el espesor de una mitad: atravesaría la cara exterior. Reduce hinge_cavity_radius o engrosa las mitades.

message.en: The camera half is wider than the cover half. A book fold closes because one half is narrower; with this the closed width is set by the wrong half and no longer matches the published closed envelope.
message.es: La mitad de cámara es más ancha que la de portada. Un plegable de libro cierra porque una mitad es más estrecha; así el ancho cerrado lo fija la mitad equivocada.

message.en: The inner and outer display recesses together are deeper than a half-frame is thick: they would meet and open a hole.
